# Calder, email infrastructure for applications

Calder sends email for applications: transactional mail (verification codes,
password resets, receipts, invoices, security alerts, order updates) through a
versioned REST API or an SMTP relay, and marketing mail (newsletters, launches,
promotions, lifecycle) on a separate stream with its own audiences, consent,
suppression and reputation. Both run over one pipeline: one API, one event log,
one webhook system, one usage meter.

Free to start: 5,000 emails a month, 3 projects, 2 sending domains, no card.
Pro is $15 or ₦25,000 for 50,000 emails with development, staging and production
environments. Premium is $49 or ₦75,000 for 250,000. Scale is custom volume and
pricing. Naira and dollar prices are separate local price points, not currency
conversions. Hard limits, never surprise overages.
